description: The harness runner checks on the tank runner with a real language model: any Hugging Face checkpoint SGLang loads (HONING_SGLANG_CHECKPOINT) answers /v1/decide through Honing's lettered readout, served on demand by SGLangPolicyEndpoints on HONING_SGLANG_GPUS. Needs a GPU and the SGLang environment (SGLANG_PYTHON).
